title: Jobs of Tomorrow
text:
Many young people today expect to change careers several times during their lives. Ten years ago, most workers stayed with one company until they retired. Now, rapid technological change means that some skills become outdated within a few years. As a result, employers increasingly look for people who are willing to keep learning.

Experts predict that artificial intelligence will remove some routine tasks, but it will also create new roles that did not exist before. Data analysts, renewable energy engineers and online teachers are examples of jobs that have grown quickly. Students who develop flexible skills, such as communication and problem solving, are likely to adapt most easily.

questions.text: What do many young people today expect to do during their lives?
options: Stay with one company until retirement
Start their own business at eighteen

questions.text: According to the passage, what will artificial intelligence do to some tasks?
options: Stop the growth of new jobs

questions.text: What can be inferred about skills in today's job market?
options: They remain useful for a whole lifetime
They are less important than work experience
They are only needed in technology jobs

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about students who develop flexible skills?
options: They will probably struggle to find work
They will probably adapt well to change
They should avoid jobs in new fields
They need to choose one career early

vocabulary.definition: the jobs and professional paths that a person follows during their working life
done regularly as a normal, repeated part of work
to change in order to deal successfully with new conditions

paragraph_translations: Багато молодих людей сьогодні очікують, що протягом життя кілька разів змінять кар'єру. Десять років тому більшість працівників залишалися в одній компанії до пенсії. Тепер швидкі технологічні зміни означають, що деякі навички застаряють за кілька років. Тому роботодавці дедалі частіше шукають людей, які готові постійно вчитися.

Експерти прогнозують, що штучний інтелект усуне деякі рутинні завдання, але також створить нові посади, яких раніше не було. Аналітики даних, інженери з відновлюваної енергетики та викладачі онлайн є прикладами професій, що швидко зростають. Студенти, які розвивають гнучкі навички, наприклад комунікацію та вирішення проблем, найімовірніше, легше пристосуються.
